prompts.prompt: A white towel caught mid-air as it falls through the ropes into an empty boxing ring, frozen in motion, lit by a single harsh overhead arena light that leaves the surrounding seats in total blackness. Documentary photojournalism, shot from ringside at floor level, cold white key light against deep black, slight motion blur on the fabric. Absolutely no people, no faces, no text, no logos

Two heavyweight boxer silhouettes in near-total darkness, one backed against the ring ropes with his head down and arms hanging low, the other advancing on him in a flat forward stance. Rim lighting only, figures rendered as pure black shapes against a smoky amber haze, ropes cutting hard diagonal lines across the frame. Cinematic wide shot, high contrast, exhaustion and inevitability. No visible faces, no identifiable features, no text, no logos

An evidence table in a dim federal courthouse conference room, a row of switched-off mobile phones laid out in numbered clear plastic bags, one bag conspicuously empty. Cold blue-grey daylight through vertical blinds, muted desaturated palette, sharp editorial still life, shallow depth of field. No people, no faces, no readable text, no logos

An empty arena in a northern English city seen from the upper tier at night, house lights off, only the work lights over a bare ring in the center, scaffolding and stacked chairs at the edges. Wide desaturated documentary shot, cool grey and dull orange, a venue waiting for a date that has not happened yet. No people, no faces, no text, no logos

Five pairs of boxing and MMA gloves arranged in a single row on weathered dark wood, each pair distinct in age and wear, lit from a low raking angle so the leather texture and stitching read sharply. Fine art still life, warm tungsten light against a near-black background, painterly and restrained. No people, no faces, no text, no logos

An unmarked championship belt lying face down on a bare negotiating table beside a closed briefcase and a single pulled-out empty chair, in a hotel meeting room with the lights half off. Cold institutional lighting, desaturated greens and greys, wide flat composition emphasizing empty space, the mood of a transaction rather than a sport. No people, no faces, no text, no logos, no insignia on the belt

Rear view from directly behind a heavyweight boxer sitting alone on a stool in an empty locker room, the camera positioned behind his back so only his shoulders, the back of his shaved head and his taped hands resting at his sides are visible. His head is turned completely away from the camera. A warm shaft of light falls across his back from an open doorway ahead of him, lockers and a wooden bench receding into shadow. Painterly chiaroscuro oil study, deep amber and umber tones, dignity and late-career weariness. Strictly a back view, no face, no profile, no reflection, no mirrors, no other people, no text, no logos
